name: THE OPTIMIZER
description: You want a system you can trust because you can see it working. Proof matters more than comfort.

name: THE PRAGMATIST
description: You want things that fit into your life, feel credible, and don't ask much of you in return.

name: THE RITUALIST
description: You want a routine that feels like yours — dependable, grounding, a small daily anchor.

name: THE STRIVER
description: You want to become someone. You're drawn to things that make progress feel visible.

name: THE SOCIAL EXPLORER
description: You want to feel plugged in — to what's happening, to who you're becoming, to who's watching.
